packageRules.description: Never group unrelated packages into one PR - each update stays individually reviewable.
Majors get a longer cooldown and explicit dashboard approval before a branch is even created.
Digest-only updates of already-pinned images carry no new version, so the age gate does not apply.
Base images ship inside the release images, so updating them is a fix(deps): it cuts a patch release instead of waiting for the next feat or fix.

The React client (#122) runs on staging only until the cutover, so nothing in frontend-next/ ships in a release yet: its updates stay chore(deps) instead of cutting patch releases. Move frontend-next/Dockerfile into the rule above and delete this one at the cutover.
Backend runtime dependencies ship in the image too. Dev dependency groups stay chore(deps). pubspec `dependencies` already get fix from config:recommended.
